value.rationale: The source classifies qualitative periodic behavior, leaving the natural uncertainty-quantification question of phase selection unresolved. The new theorem provides every finite-time ensemble law, exact total-variation distance and full capture-time distribution for a nonarbitrary polygonal section over an open two-parameter family. It isolates a parameter-independent geometric decay factor 1/4 despite a nonconstant phase-bias law and identifies the known boundary b=2a where phases merge. It is a complete and useful quantitative invariant for this family, not a claim of creating new cycles or of global planar statistics.
